purpose: Fixed-value equation checks for heating components; not engineering acceptance, Australian compliance, or DA09/CAMEL parity.

ashrae_loads.title: ASHRAE Handbook—Fundamentals (2025), Chapter 18: Nonresidential Cooling and Heating Load Calculations
ashrae_loads.supports: Heating-load calculation context and sensible ventilation-load relationship. Section 3.1 discusses standard-air volume and the distinction between mass-flow and point-state volume bases; fixture arithmetic uses the calculator's explicitly declared 1.2 kg dry-air/m³ and 1.006 kJ/(kg dry air·K) constants.

ashrae_psychrometrics.title: ASHRAE Handbook—Fundamentals (2025), Chapter 1: Psychrometrics
ashrae_psychrometrics.supports: IAPWS liquid-water saturation pressure (Eq. 5), thermodynamic wet-bulb relation (Eq. 33), and moist-air specific volume (Eq. 28) used in the fixed infiltration case.

archie_heating_v1.title: Archie hourly heating V1 documented calculation policy
archie_heating_v1.supports: Software arithmetic for explicit sensible-only scheduled internal-gain credits, capping the credit at gross heating demand. This is not an external engineering reference or approval of the policy.

rounding_policy.meaning: Allowance for the calculation result's four-decimal rounding only; not an engineering acceptance tolerance.

cases.equation: Q = U × area × (indoor temperature − boundary temperature) ÷ 1000
assumptions: Supplied U-value includes the construction layers and surface resistances intended by the design input

cases.equation: ṁda = flow × 1.2 kg_da/m³; Q = ṁda × 1.006 kJ/(kg_da·K) × (indoor DB − outdoor DB)
assumptions: The selected flow reference is explicitly standard air at 1.2 kg dry air/m³
Wet-bulb states are valid inputs required by the API but do not set this sensible-only result
exclusions: Whether a real project airflow schedule uses standard-air volume

cases.equation: Heating demand = max(ṁda × 1.006 × (indoor DB − outdoor DB), 0)
assumptions: Same declared standard-air reference as the heating case above
exclusions: Cooling load from this warm outdoor air

cases.equation: V̇ = ACH × volume ÷ 3.6; ṁda = (V̇ × schedule factor) ÷ vout; Q = ṁda × 1.006 × (indoor DB − outdoor DB)
assumptions: ASHRAE F25 Eqs. 5, 28, and 33 applied to the 5°C dry-bulb / 2°C thermodynamic wet-bulb outdoor state
Infiltration volume is referenced to the outdoor state as fixed by the existing V1 method policy
Expected flow, humidity ratio, specific volume, and sensible load were independently calculated from the stated equations and constants
Psychrometric conditions remain valid even at zero flow

cases.equation: requested sensible credit = (people × W/person × people schedule + area × W/m² × lighting schedule + Σ confirmed equipment heat-to-space watts × quantity × equipment schedule) ÷ 1000; applied credit = −min(gross heating sensible demand, requested credit)
assumptions: All rates and heat-to-space values are fixed synthetic inputs
The test verifies Archie V1 arithmetic and cap only, not whether a project is entitled to these credits
